title: Electronics
content: The branch of physics and technology concerned with the design of circuits using transistors, integrated circuits and microchips, and also with the behaviour and movement of electrons in a semiconductor, conductor or vacuum is known as electronics.
e: Electronics: The branch of physics and technology concerned with the design of circuits using transistors, integrated circuits and microchips, and also with the behaviour and movement of electrons in a semiconductor, conductor or vacuum is known as electronics. A transistor is an active switch or amplifier that needs a power supply to work.

title: Zener Diode
content: Zener diode is a heavily doped semiconductor (silicon or germanium) pn junction diode.
e: Zener diode is a heavily doped semiconductor (silicon or germanium) pn junction diode. A zener is heavily doped so reverse breakdown is sharp and usable as a voltage clamp.

title: Zener effect
content: When the voltage across the terminals of a zener diode is reversed and the potential reaches the zener voltage (Vz) (breakdown voltage or knee voltage), the junction breaks down and the current flow in the reverse direction. This effect is known as the zener effect.
e: Zener effect: When the voltage across the terminals of a zener diode is reversed and the potential reaches the zener voltage (Vz) (breakdown voltage or knee voltage), the junction breaks down and the current flow in the reverse direction. This effect is known as the zener effect. A diode lets current through one way and blocks the other, the pn junction rectifier.

title: Light Emitting Diode (LED)
content: A LED is a semiconductor light source that emits light when current flows through it. It is a semiconductor light source capable of emitting a fairly narrow bandwidth of visible or invisible light when its internal diode junction attains a forward-biased current or voltage.
e: Light Emitting Diode (LED): A LED is a semiconductor light source that emits light when current flows through it. It is a semiconductor light source capable of emitting a fairly narrow bandwidth of visible or invisible light when its internal diode junction attains a forward-biased current or voltage. Current is charge passing a point each second, and it needs a closed path.

title: Photodiode
content: A photodiode is a semiconductor device that converts light into electric current.
e: Photodiode: A photodiode is a semiconductor device that converts light into electric current. A photodiode turns light into current; reverse bias is the usual sensing mode.

title: Light Dependent Resistor (Photoresistor/ Photocell)
content: A light dependent resistor (LDR) is a light controlled variable resistor.
e: Light Dependent Resistor (Photoresistor/ Photocell): A light dependent resistor (LDR) is a light controlled variable resistor. An LDR drops resistance as light rises, so it is a light-controlled resistor.

title: Thermistor
content: A thermistor is a temperature sensor that exhibits a large change in resistance proportional to a change in temperature.
e: Thermistor: A thermistor is a temperature sensor that exhibits a large change in resistance proportional to a change in temperature. Resistance opposes current and turns electrical energy into heat.

title: Liquid Crystal
content: Liquid crystals are a state of matter, which has the properties between those of conventional liquids and those of solid crystals.
e: Liquid crystals are a state of matter, which has the properties between those of conventional liquids and those of solid crystals. Liquid crystals sit between ordinary liquids and solid crystals in their molecular order.

title: Liquid Crystal Display (LCD)
content: A liquid crystal display (LCD) is a flat-panel display, or other electronically modulated optical device that uses the light-modulating properties of liquid crystals combined with polarizers.
e: Liquid Crystal Display (LCD): A liquid crystal display (LCD) is a flat-panel display, or other electronically modulated optical device that uses the light-modulating properties of liquid crystals combined with polarizers. An LCD twists polarized light through a liquid-crystal layer instead of emitting light.

title: Polarizer
content: A polarizer is an optical device that can convert an unpolarized light wave into a polarize light wave by blocking all other vibrations.
e: Polarizer: A polarizer is an optical device that can convert an unpolarized light wave into a polarize light wave by blocking all other vibrations. A polarizer passes one vibration and blocks the rest, making unpolarized light polarized.

title: Digital Electronics
content: Digital electronics is a field of electronics involving the study of digital signals, and the engineering of devices that use or produce them.
e: Digital electronics is a field of electronics involving the study of digital signals, and the engineering of devices that use or produce them. Digital electronics deals with two-level signals and the hardware that makes them.

title: IC
content: An IC (integrated circuit), sometimes called a chip or microchip, is a semiconductor wafer on which thousands or millions of tiny resistors, capacitors and transistors are fabricated.
e: IC: An IC (integrated circuit), sometimes called a chip or microchip, is a semiconductor wafer on which thousands or millions of tiny resistors, capacitors and transistors are fabricated. Resistance opposes current and turns electrical energy into heat.

title: Boolean algebra
content: Boolean algebra is a branch of mathematics where variables can have only two possible values: false and true, or logic values 0 and 1.
e: Boolean algebra is a branch of mathematics where variables can have only two possible values: false and true, or logic values 0 and 1. Boolean variables are only 0 or 1, false or true, which is the algebra of gates.

title: Information source
content: It is a device that generates information (messages or data) to be transmitted.
e: Information source: It is a device that generates information (messages or data) to be transmitted. Device that generates information (messages or data) to be transmitted. Information source.

title: Transmitter
content: It is the arrangement that processes the message signal into an appropriate form for transmission and subsequent reception.
e: Transmitter: It is the arrangement that processes the message signal into an appropriate form for transmission and subsequent reception. The transmitter shapes the message for the channel so a receiver can pick it up.

title: Channel
content: It is the medium that connects transmitter and receiver to convey the information.
e: Channel: It is the medium that connects transmitter and receiver to convey the information. The receiver rebuilds the sent signal and hands it to the user.

title: Noise
content: Noise is an unwanted signal that disturbs, interferes and affects the transmitted signal.
e: Noise is an unwanted signal that disturbs, interferes and affects the transmitted signal. Noise is the unwanted disturbance that rides on the wanted signal.

title: Receiver
content: The receiver is to reconstruct the transmitted signal and delivers it to the destination called user of information.
e: Receiver: The receiver is to reconstruct the transmitted signal and delivers it to the destination called user of information. The receiver rebuilds the sent signal and hands it to the user.

title: Analog Communication
content: Analog communication is process transferred of voice, and conveying (sending, receiving, and processing) of information including image, voice and video by using analog signals.
e: Analog communication is process transferred of voice, and conveying (sending, receiving, and processing) of information including image, voice and video by using analog signals. Analog communication sends a continuously varying wave for voice, image, or video.

title: Wired (Line) Communication
content: In line communication, there is a physical connection between source and destination.
e: Wired (Line) Communication: In line communication, there is a physical connection between source and destination. Line communication keeps a physical wire or fibre between source and destination.

title: Transducer
content: A transducer is a device for converting a non-electrical input into an electrical signal, or vice versa.
e: Transducer: A transducer is a device for converting a non-electrical input into an electrical signal, or vice versa. A transducer converts a non-electrical input to an electrical signal, or the reverse.

title: Transduction
content: The process of converting energy from one form to another is known as transduction.
e: Transduction: The process of converting energy from one form to another is known as transduction. A transducer converts a non-electrical input to an electrical signal, or the reverse.

title: Sensor
content: Sensor is a device which produces a measurable response due to a change in physical conditions.
e: Sensor is a device which produces a measurable response due to a change in physical conditions. A sensor gives a measurable electrical response when a physical condition changes.

title: Modulation
content: The process of changing some characteristics (e.g amplitude, frequency or phase) of a carrier wave (e.g radio wave) in accordance with the intensity of the signal is known as modulation.
e: Modulation: The process of changing some characteristics (e.g amplitude, frequency or phase) of a carrier wave (e.g radio wave) in accordance with the intensity of the signal is known as modulation. Modulation writes the message onto amplitude, frequency, or phase of a carrier.

title: Amplitude modulation
content: When the amplitude of high frequency carrier wave is changed in accordance with the intensity of the signal, it is called amplitude modulation.
e: Amplitude modulation: When the amplitude of high frequency carrier wave is changed in accordance with the intensity of the signal, it is called amplitude modulation. AM changes carrier amplitude with the signal strength.

title: Frequency modulation
content: When the frequency of carrier wave is changed in accordance with the intensity of the signal, it is called frequency modulation (FM).
e: Frequency modulation: When the frequency of carrier wave is changed in accordance with the intensity of the signal, it is called frequency modulation (FM). FM changes carrier frequency with the signal strength.

title: Phase modulation
content: Phase modulation is a modulation pattern that encodes information as variations in the instantaneous phase of a carrier wave.
e: Phase modulation is a modulation pattern that encodes information as variations in the instantaneous phase of a carrier wave. Phase modulation writes the message as swings in the carrier's instantaneous phase.

title: Demodulation or detection
content: The process of recovering the audio signal from the modulated wave is known as demodulation or detection.
e: Demodulation or detection: The process of recovering the audio signal from the modulated wave is known as demodulation or detection. Demodulation peels the audio or data back off the modulated carrier.

title: Demodulator
content: A demodulator is an electronic circuit (or computer program in a software defined radio) that is used to recover the information content from the modulated carrier wave.
e: Demodulator: A demodulator is an electronic circuit (or computer program in a software defined radio) that is used to recover the information content from the modulated carrier wave. Demodulation peels the audio or data back off the modulated carrier.
